consequence.statement: `type: opa` authorization still works but will be removed in a future release.
consequence.remediation: Use `type: custom` authorization to keep using the Open Policy Agent authorizer.

original.statement: The Open Policy Agent authorization (`type: opa`) is deprecated and will be removed in the future; `type: custom` authorization can be used instead.

decision.reason: [ev-b55698b84a79] says `type: opa` authorization "has been deprecated and will be removed in the future" and that `type: custom` can be used instead. It doesn't say that anything fails, is rejected or stops working in 0.46.0. That makes deprecation the right kind: the class is review, the remediation matches the evidence and low severity fits.
